findings.summary: Generated zconf.h excluded from header install rule
findings.evidence: CMake installs ZLIB_PUBLIC_HDRS = {${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zconf.h, zlib.h} to INSTALL_INC_DIR. Bazel install_files__usr_local_include only lists srcs = ["zlib.h"]; the generated zconf.h (produced by gen_zconf_h write_file) is absent.

findings.summary: Library targets (zlib shared, zlibstatic) have no pkg_files install rules
findings.evidence: CMake installs both zlib (RUNTIME→bin, LIBRARY→lib) and zlibstatic (ARCHIVE→lib). The Bazel BUILD has pkg_files rules only for headers and the man page; neither //elements/zlib:zlib nor //elements/zlib:zlibstatic is referenced by any pkg_files rule.

CMake installs ${ZLIB_PC} to ${INSTALL_PKGCONFIG_DIR} (share/pkgconfig). No pkg_files rule for share/pkgconfig exists in the Bazel BUILD; gen_zlib_pc has visibility=private and is only consumed by the zlib cc_library hdrs list.

findings.summary: zlib.map version-script linker flag missing from shared library
findings.evidence: CMake sets LINK_FLAGS "-Wl,--version-script,\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib.map\"" on the zlib target for Unix/non-Apple/non-AIX. Bazel zlib cc_library only has linkopts=["-shared"]; the version-script flag is absent, so the ABI symbol visibility contract expressed in zlib.map is not enforced at link time.

findings.summary: example64 and minigzip64 targets are unconditional; CMake gates them on HAVE_OFF64_T
findings.evidence: CMake wraps the add_executable(example64) and add_executable(minigzip64) blocks inside if(HAVE_OFF64_T). Bazel emits cc_test(example64) and cc_binary(minigzip64) unconditionally, so on platforms where off64_t is absent these targets would fail to compile.
